# awscc_scn_dataset (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::SCN::Dataset

## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the dataset.
- `created_time` (String) The creation time of the dataset.
- `description` (String) The description of the dataset.
- `instance_id` (String) The Amazon Web Services Supply Chain instance identifier.
- `last_modified_time` (String) The last modified time of the dataset.
- `name` (String) The name of the dataset.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the dataset.
- `partition_spec` (Attributes) The partition specification of the dataset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--partition_spec))
- `schema` (Attributes) The schema of the dataset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schema))
- `tags` (Attributes Set) The tags for the dataset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
